Source logic/clock/uncertainties unchanged; original a/b progress preserved. Terminal physical evidence cannot adopt before actual controller-pair exactness and die pin/relay context gates.

bench.name: wide_slot_prebuild_model
bench.cmd: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'tools'); from uarch_model import qwen_ctlm_deep_queue_model; j=qwen_ctlm_deep_queue_model(); v=next(v for v in j['variants'] if v['name']=='wide1036'); assert v['floorplan']['reticle_fit'] and v['floorplan']['vertical_fit']; print('PASS qwen_ctlm_wide_model')"

calibrate.reason: die-context IO referenced in-run (io_ref_skew.sdc) as every Qwen die master

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/qwen_die_masters/signoff/qfd_tt_ctlm_a.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 OT_PIN_BALANCE_H='M4 M6' OT_PIN_BALANCE_V='M5 M7' PIN_H='M4 M6' PIN_V='M5 M7' bash physical/qwen_die_masters/jobs/route_master.sh qfd_tt_ctlm_wide1036 {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/w18/export_view.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name qfd_tt_ctlm_wide1036 --post-sdc physical/qwen_die_masters/signoff/qfd_tt_ctlm_a.sdc --corners ss,tt,ff --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_tt_ctlm_wide1036 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
